name: Crucible Genomics BioSec Full Tactical Kit
description: Deep viridian and bone-white hard-shell armor over adaptive bioweave fatigues, marked with Crucible's double-helix sigil in bioluminescent jade across the chest plate and helmet. The full-face respirator helmet integrates gene-scan optics and airborne pathogen filters rated for Level-4 containment breaches. Load-bearing vest carries specimen containment pouches, breach charges, and a corded med-injector rail. Boots are sealed biosafe rubber over composite toe, chemical-resistant to Crucible's own experimental compounds.
functionality: Provides Level-4 pathogen containment, gene-scan HUD integration, and chemical resistance rated for Crucible laboratory breach scenarios.
what_it_says: You are Crucible's property first, a soldier second — deployed to protect assets that bleed profit.
story_hooks: A BioSec operative's helmet gene-scanner flags a civilian as an escaped proprietary geneline — someone is walking around with Crucible IP written into their DNA.
The kit's containment pouches hold something that isn't a specimen — it's a keycard and a handwritten note.

physical_description.visual_profile: A complete tactical biocontainment suit presenting as militaristic and clinical—hard-edged silhouette with layered armor plating over sleek fatigues. The deep viridian exoskeletons contrast sharply against bone-white accent panels and bioluminescent jade sigils that glow faintly in low light. The full-face respirator dominates the upper body, giving an inhuman, biomechanical presence. Suggests elite corporate security or hazmat field operative.
physical_description.fit: Compression-tailored under armor, with articulated hard-shell plates allowing full mobility. The load-bearing vest sits snug over the chest and torso, distributing weight evenly. Overall athletic and utilitarian—built for function over aesthetic comfort.
physical_description.primary_material: Hard-shell composite armor plating (viridian and bone-white) over adaptive bioweave fatigues; sealed biosafe rubber boots with composite reinforcement; integrated polymer respirator system
physical_description.texture: Smooth, hard shell exterior with slight tactical grip ridges; bioweave fatigues have a fine ribbed texture underneath; matte finish on armor with semi-gloss accents on visor and metal fittings; rubber boots have raised tread patterns
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep viridian as primary armor color, bone-white secondary panels and trim, bioluminescent jade accents on double-helix sigils (chest plate and helmet), dark gray fatigues underneath, matte black connector joints and utility hardware
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap closures on armor segments for rapid removal post-contamination, friction-fit bioseal zippers running down the sides of the fatigues, boot laces reinforced with chemical-resistant webbing, helmet respirator locked via mechanical twist-lock with secondary magnetic safety
distinctive_features: Full-face respirator helmet with integrated gene-scan optics and Level-4 airborne pathogen filtration system
Bioluminescent jade double-helix sigil (Crucible Genomics branding) glowing on chest plate and helmet
Specimen containment pouches stitched into load-bearing vest with biohazard warning labels
Corded med-injector rail running along right shoulder, pre-loaded with emergency pharmaceuticals
Breach charge attachment points on thigh and shoulder armor
Sealed biosafe rubber boots with chemical-resistant sole formulation proprietary to Crucible
Reinforced composite toe caps for heavy industrial use
Microfibrous gasket seals visible around neck, wrists, and ankles
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury (corporate elite), Tier 2 security contractor—cost prohibitive, restricted distribution, bleeding-edge biotech integration
physical_description.cultural_context: Marks the wearer as Crucible Genomics internal security, research breach-response team, or hazmat containment specialist. Signals corporate authority, access to restricted biotech zones, and clearance for Level-4 contamination events. Not street wear; ownership implies direct employment or black-market acquisition from corporate theft.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly used—maintained meticulously due to biohazard protocols. Visor may show fingerprint residue or microbial culture marks if actively deployed. Armor plating rarely shows cosmetic wear but will show chemical etching or discoloration from exposure to experimental compounds during field use.
